mainEntity.name: What is AEO and how does it apply to pest control businesses?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO stands for Answer Engine Optimization. It's a digital marketing strategy focused on optimizing online content so that search engines, especially those with AI-driven answer capabilities, can directly use it to answer user questions. For pest control businesses, AEO means structuring website content, FAQs, and service descriptions to directly address common customer inquiries about pests, treatments, and prevention, leading to higher visibility in search results and voice assistant responses.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) helps pest control businesses appear in direct answers on search engines and voice assistants by structuring content to answer common customer questions.
